name: Nihongo Master v1.1.1
changelog: v1.1.1: Always runs at full screen mode. After selecting a card, selection focus automatically returns to the hand cards so players don't have to press down. Removed the circular ring around highlighted cards in favor of a clean, elevated 3D pop and gold border. On the title screen, all selectable games (Hiragana Arcade, Katakana Arcade, 3D Hiragana Cards) are permanently visible side-by-side in distinct cards with direct menu selection.
